structured.answer: After 8 years, putting in 500 ₪ a month, I'd have about 68,853 ₪ in hand. For 4 years the calculator doesn't give self-employed people a number at all. It only says that taking the money out before 6 years means paying tax.

stuck.why: No fund figure, only empty dashed bars and an orange note saying there is no calculation for self-employed people before 6 years. The only number shown (25,725) was for a different thing, a securities account.
The bars go left to right while I read from the right, so the first big number I saw was the securities-account bar, not the fund's result.

used: Heading קרן השתלמות and the line about 6 שנים
Orange note לעצמאים עוד אין כאן חישוב
Bar labels and numbers at year 8: הפקדתם 48,000, נשאר בידיים 68,853, אותו כסף בחשבון ניירות ערך 55,471
skipped: Grey text about 7% return and 2% fees/inflation
Tabs שווה לדעת, מי מציע ומי מצטרף
Rest of the page below the calculator
not_found: Any amount for a self-employed person withdrawing after 4 years

findings.what: For self-employed people there's no result at all for withdrawing before 6 years, which is half of what I came to check
At year 4 the only big number (25,725) belongs to the securities-account comparison, so it's easy to mistake it for what the fund would give
Bars run left to right while the text is right to left, so the comparison bar is read first and the fund result comes second
Years 1–5 show empty dashed boxes with no explanation right next to them
"+9,581 החזר המס הוסיף" isn't explained: why would I get a tax refund?
The field label "הכנסה חייבת" is unclear to a regular person
